title: Return to work & sport
summary: Questions about work, daily tasks and your usual activities.

blocks.text: Use these questions as a starting point for a conversation with your treating team.

sections.heading: Questions to ask your treating team

items: What restrictions should I discuss for my work or sport?
Who should assess when I can resume each activity?
What follow-up will help me plan my return?

blocks.text: Follow the individual instructions provided by your treating team.
